source.title: Jewelcrafting 40/40 gem finding broken? No ambers
source.author: Eddiezato-illidan

quote: i prospected 5000 aqirite without getting a single extra amber
outputName: Ambivalent Amber — conditional 40/40 extra byproduct only
specialization: Gem Finding 40/40 acquired the same day
notes: Original firsthand Sept 3 2024 report explicitly says 5,000 Aqirite ore were prospected and ZERO additional Ambivalent Amber procs from Gem Finding 40/40; Sept 4 followup reiterates 0 extra. No rank, exact number of completed 5-ore casts, Resourcefulness/reprocessed-input basis, ordinary base Amber count, per-cast event histogram, skill/equipment or build. Source's zero refers ONLY to bonus Ambers, NOT total Ambivalent Amber output, hence numerical totalQuantity and castsWithDrop are null. Historical bug before Blizzard Oct 25 2024 hotfix; reference-only, DO NOT use as 0% yield or current probability. Distinct from existing Sep 17 condition war-within-20261030-409 and not an independent controlled post-hotfix sample.
